title: CubeSat Structural Analysis
description: Applying finite element analysis in Ansys Mechanical to validate the structural integrity of the 2×3×4 and 4×6 CubeSat chassis designs under launch-load conditions — exploring material trade-offs between aluminium alloy and carbon-fibre composites.

title: Sustainable Design in Engineering
description: Investigating lifecycle assessment methodologies and eco-design principles — inspired by CSWA Sustainable Design — with a focus on reducing embodied carbon in manufactured components through material selection and design-for-disassembly strategies.

title: Design for Manufacturability
description: Exploring design-for-manufacturability (DFM) principles to optimize component geometry, tolerances, and assembly processes — aiming to reduce production costs and improve yield in small-batch manufacturing.

title: Material Characterization of Composites
description: Conducting experimental testing and analysis of composite materials to determine mechanical properties, failure modes, and environmental durability — informing material selection for aerospace and automotive applications.

title: Parametric Design Optimization
description: Utilizing parametric modeling techniques to explore design variations and optimize performance metrics such as weight, strength, and aerodynamics — leveraging computational tools for rapid iteration.

title: Sustainable Packaging Solutions
description: Researching biodegradable materials and innovative packaging designs to minimize environmental impact — focusing on reducing plastic waste and improving recyclability in consumer products.

title: Additive Manufacturing Process Development
description: Investigating additive manufacturing techniques for complex geometries, including process parameter optimization, material selection, and post-processing methods to enhance part quality and performance.
